rule_based.label: Based on data, not yet reviewed by agents
rule_based.rule: Operators ranked by line of sight from this point to their nearest identified site (clear, then marginal, then blocked); clear lines by distance, obstructed ones by how far the ground rises above the line.
rule_based.text: No operator has a clear line of sight to an identified site from here. Least obstructed: O2, a site 5.7 km south-east (inferred from crowd-sourced data), with terrain 129 m above the line.

limitations: Sites are approximate; antenna heights assumed; Ofcom figures are area-level.
Causes are inferred from public data, not confirmed: operators' network data is not public.
Ookla speeds are quarterly aggregates with no time-of-day detail; congestion can only be inferred.
No address-level Ofcom coverage; Ofcom figures are for the whole constituency and are predictions.
Mast sites are approximate (crowd-sourced OpenCelliD, OpenStreetMap, Ofcom's licence register) and incomplete, so 'no sites found' is weak evidence.
Line of sight uses a surface model (trees and buildings included) and mostly assumed antenna heights; blocked means a weaker signal, not no signal.

critiques.reason: Four independent line-of-sight analyses show terrain rising 129–288 m above the direct line to each operator's nearest site (with assumed 25 m antenna heights) [los_ee][los_o2][los_three][los_vodafone]. The network comparison confirms no operator has a clear line of sight [network_comparison], and a prior diagnosis within 10 km also identified hills as the likely cause [prior_diagnoses]. The assumed antenna height is a minor weakness, but the magnitude of obstruction makes blocking highly likely.

The nearest identified mast is 3.8 km away and only three operators have sites within 5 km [nearest_site][operators_5km], but the evidence consistently shows terrain blocking is the dominant obstruction [los_ee][los_o2][los_three][los_vodafone][network_comparison]. The confidence appropriately reflects that distance is a contributing factor but not the primary cause [los_ee][los_o2][los_three][los_vodafone][nearest_site][network_comparison][operators_5km]. Crowd-sourced site locations are a moderate weakness.

The weather evidence (dense drizzle, gusts up to 76 km/h, yellow wind warning) [weather][met_office_warnings] is short-lived, while the prior diagnosis from 2026-10-26 points to a persistent terrain cause [prior_diagnoses]. A live forecast cannot explain long-standing poor service; at most it explains a temporary drop. Confidence should be reduced to ≤0.3.
